intro: Between May and August 2026, ZCyberNews covered ten denial-of-service incidents affecting telecommunications, technology, enterprise networking, software development, and academic sectors globally. Coverage centered on five critical-severity vulnerabilities, each rated CVSS 9.2: CVE-2026-34176, CVE-2026-39459, CVE-2026-41225, CVE-2026-41957, and CVE-2026-42945. The reporting mix comprised six high-severity, two medium-severity, and two critical-severity cases. These stories tracked exploit attempts and mitigation efforts across the affected industries, with no single threat actor identified in the observed coverage. The archive provides a technical record of the period’s most significant availability attacks.
